name: Phoenix
description_html:
This flower arrangement is blooming with bright pink peonies.

Like a breath of fresh air, these delicate pink blooms are seriously charming. You don’t need to be a flower expert to see why our peonies always sell out. These massive blooms are bursting with color, texture, and gorgeousness. Order yours before this magically mythical Bouq flies away!

Pro Tip: Your flowers will arrive fresh in our recyclable Bouqs box and may still be in bud form. This maximizes their shelf life, so they’ll last as long as possible! Please allow 2-3 days for your new buds to open and reach full bloom.

Please Note: While we always try our best to match the bouquet pictured, we remain dedicated to fresh, high-quality flowers. Occasionally substitutions including color variation or supplemental flower type may occur to ensure you receive our farmers’ freshest possible selection.

Due to local restrictions, this Bouq cannot be delivered to Hawaii.

name: Orion
description_html:
This floral arrangement is composed of fresh white peonies.

Talk about a superstar! These white peonies, like the stars in Orion, are the brightest of the bunch. Knowledge is flower: their huge-yet-delicate blooms expand almost as big as the universe itself! (One could say...they're out of this world.) Since they sell out quickly, we recommend getting them lunar rather than later.

Pro Tip: Your flowers will arrive fresh in our recyclable Bouqs box and may still be in bud form. This maximizes their shelf life, so they’ll last as long as possible! Please allow 2-3 days for your new buds to open and reach full bloom.
